question: NVFP4在Compute Capability 7.0 (V100)上的实际执行效率：由于缺乏原生FP4指令，NVFP4权重需在加载时反量化或在线转换为FP16/INT8，导致实际计算密度降至FP16峰值算力的~80-90%（取决于kernel实现），且显存占用从理论4-bit回退至16-bit，使得HBM带宽瓶颈成为主要限制因素而非计算能力

sources.title: GitHub - 1CatAI/1Cat-vLLM: V100 / SM70-focused vLLM engineering fork ...
sources.snippet: The three profiles use FP16 compute, up to eight scheduled sequences, a 4096-token prefill budget, and a 262144-token service limit. The 27B runs use the Unsloth NVFP4 checkpoint. Flash-Next uses NVFP4 with FP16 attention KV and host-backed FP8 E4M3 QSA history. See the launch profiles below for the KV and draft settings.
